# CORE-QA-01

**Does the design state quality-attribute scenarios with a stimulus, a response and a measurable response measure?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Core architecture lens](core.md) 0.6.0 |
| Area | QA: Quality attributes |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool checks presence; a reviewer judges |
| Reads | `scenarios` |

## Why it matters

A quality that is not stated as a measurable scenario cannot be assessed, only argued about.

## Rule

At least one scenario of type quality exists, and every quality, failure or misuse scenario has stimulus, response, response_measure and importance (the schema enforces the fields).

## Sources

- SEI, Architecture Tradeoff Analysis Method (`atam`)
- ISO/IEC 25010:2023, Product quality model (`iso25010`)
- ISO/IEC/IEEE 42030:2019, Architecture evaluation framework (`iso42030`)
